reference: Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.
hypothesis: Ke wa de ke wa be he kpee ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie, nɛ anɔkwale ɔ be wa mi.

reference: Nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye.
hypothesis: Nyegbe hii, nyepu nyɛ jee nɔ mi nyɔ chami ɔ mi, nganyochuano mi. Pi kɛ hemi somomi, nɛ mahanye nyɔ chami ɔ mi, ma sɔ nyɛ sane. Mo huɔ, nyepu mɛ kachie nyɛ tsumi, kanyi nɛ yo Mawu gbee.

reference: Bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ tsɔe.
hypothesis: O nɛ o tsɔ mi jio mio? Jano i mihu i ngɛ mɛ tsɔe.

reference: Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya hi si.
hypothesis: Yesu kaa kɛ tɛ liɔ mɛ kpuɔ i wɔ nɛ a ya hitɛ

reference: A mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɔ ɔ maa nɔ mi kaa gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi.
hypothesis: Amami fua wɛ, ejɛ kpa bɔfoe nyuɔmɛ ngam ma nitsue kɛ Yesu tesi kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɔ ma nɔ mi kɛ gbogboe ma tesi kɛ ba wa mimi.

reference: Se nyɛ pueɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si. Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ? Anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ?
hypothesis: Nyɛ pɔɔ hiɛ kɛ mɛ ahiɛ mi. Anɛ pimi hiɛ kɛ mɔ mi nɛ wa nye yemi yo. Anɛ pimi nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa kɔ jumi hiɛ.

reference: Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ. Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a.
hypothesis: Janne, ekuku abɔlokpagwo kɛloo nɛ enama osi nɛ ekumi nɛ enghuɔ akasɛ lɔmi nɛ akasɛ lɔmi nuhuɔ ma

reference: Apaa yeli nɛ hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ha! Ní kpali nɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ ní nya a a ngmlaa a ya su Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tue mi tɔɔ.
hypothesis: A pale nɛ hu Nyɛŋmɔ mɛ ha nyɛ. Nyɛ we mi hio. Nyɛ ye bɔne agbe kpa e bo bo ha. Nikpale nɛ bua Nyɛŋmɔ ni nyã. Aŋmlayasu nyomtsɛ tabuhia tswemi tɔ.

reference: Si kake too ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi a ta nguaa ba piɛ bɔfo ɔ he, nɛ a la kɛ je Mawu yi ke,
hypothesis: Yitakɛto. Nɔ bɔfoɔ atangba piɛ bɔfoɔ hi ne alake jemao yikɛ

reference: Sa a, nyɛ puɛ be babauu kɛ pee níhi nɛ ma je li suɔ peemi, yahomi, akɔnɔ níhi a se dimi, dã demi, fiɛmi sakasaka, jiklɔɔ peemi, kɛ wɔ jami ní kpɔtɔkpɔtɔ peemi.
hypothesis: Kpa, nye pwen pee babaoo kɛ pee ni ne amajeliswɔ pee mi. Yahomi, akɔnɔ ni ase dimi, daa demi, fee mi sakasaka, jiklɔ pee mi kɛ wɔ jami ni kpotokpoto pee mi.
